title: Calgary Flames Vancouver Canucks video review
headline: Video Review: CGY @ VAN – 1:28 of the Third Period
summary:

Result: Goal Vancouver

parts.content:
**Type of Review:** Puck Over Goal Line

**Result:** Goal Vancouver

**Explanation:** The Situation Room initiated a video review to further examine whether Liam Ohgren’s original shot entered the Calgary net while it was in the webbing of Devin Cooley’s glove. Video determined that **the puck did cross the Calgary goal line**.
